description:
Fetch and parse a domain's DMARC record (_dmarc.<domain>). Reports the policy (p=), subdomain policy (sp=), reporting addresses (rua/ruf), pct and alignment (aspf/adkim), and warns on monitor-only or partial deployments.

Args:
  - domain (string): the domain to check.
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): output format (default 'markdown').

Returns: { found, record, policy, tags{}, findings[] }.

Example: "What is paypal.com's DMARC policy?" -> dmarc_check(domain="paypal.com").

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for a human-readable summary (default) or 'json' for the full structured payload.

name: dmarc_check
title: DMARC Record Check
